# Security policy

To report a real vulnerability, use this repository's Security tab
("Report a vulnerability"), not a public issue. For a non-sensitive
security concern (an insecure code sample, a risky script), open an issue
with the security-concern template if one exists, or a normal issue
otherwise.

A maintainer acknowledges a private report and ships a fix through the
normal branch, PR, CI-green, squash-merge workflow.
